name: Pure gravity turn (no circularization)
description: The engine burns until the propellant runs out, with no second burn. Reaching orbit this way is a knife edge: the turn has to level off just as orbital speed is reached. This one flies in a vacuum (drag coefficient 0). Below about 30° the rocket falls back; at 30-32° it scrapes into a low, very elliptical orbit; above that it turns over into the ground. Turn drag on and none of them make it: the best orbit's lowest point is inside the atmosphere, and the air brings it down.
